mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 4.25% in a given month reduces near-term discount rates, lowering the present value of expected equity cash flows and thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in similar rising-rate regimes are not statistically lower than in neutral regimes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in CPIAUCSL exceeds +2% in a month, it signals accelerating inflation expectations, prompting risk-averse investors to sell equities and pushing S&P 500 forward returns negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In >60% of similar inflation spikes, 20-day forward returns remain non-negative (K-up test).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in PAYEMS of at least 5,000 jobs indicates strengthening labor market conditions, which reduces the cost of capital and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS month-over-month change ≥ +5,000 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: Over a 12-month window, 60-day forward returns during analogous labor expansions are not statistically higher than during weak expansions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 (real GDP) grows at an annualized rate above 3% for three consecutive quarters, it reflects robust consumer and business demand, which elevates equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 quarterly log growth > +3% for three consecutive quarters
failure_condition: In 10 similar expansion phases, 20-day forward returns are not higher than in neutral phases (median ratio ≤ 1).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in INDPRO (industrial production index) of more than 5% in a month signals supply-side weakness, lowering corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: During comparable INDPRO contractions, 20-day forward returns are not significantly worse than in neutral months (K-up test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in both HOUST (housing starts) and RSAFS (retail sales) above 1% monthly growth for two consecutive months suggests dual demand channels, which amplifies equity risk appetite and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST month-over-month change > +1% AND RSAFS month-over-month change > +1% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: In 50 analogous interaction periods, 20-day forward returns are not higher than in single-channel periods (median ratio ≤ 1).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4.5% for three consecutive months, it signals labor market softening, which raises real wage growth expectations and supports higher equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE month-over-month change < -0.5% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: In 12 similar cooling episodes, 60-day forward returns are not higher than in tight labor markets (median ratio ≤ 1).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in FEDFUNDS below 1% for four consecutive months indicates a prolonged easing stance by the Fed, which lowers real interest rates and increases the present value of future equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS month-over-month change < -0.25% for four consecutive months
failure_condition: In 30 similar prolonged easing episodes, 20-day forward returns are not higher than in neutral periods (t-test p > 0.05).
